Augment data with fitted values, residuals and state classification

Source: R/augment_evzinb.R
augment.evinb.Rd

Augment data with fitted values, residuals and state classification

Usage

# S3 method for class 'evinb'
augment(x, data = NULL, newdata = NULL, seed = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted evinb model.

data, newdata

Data to augment. newdata takes precedence over data when both are given (the broom convention); both default to NULL, in which case the model's own estimation data is used.

seed

Optional seed for the randomized quantile residual (.resid); see residuals(type = "quantile").

...

Unused.

Value

See augment.evzinb; evinb has no zero state, so .prob_zero/.post_zero are not produced.

Examples

# \donttest{
data(genevzinb2)
model <- evinb(y~x1+x2+x3, data=genevzinb2, n_bootstraps = 5)
#> evinf: using a data-driven candidate range for C_EV: [173, 263]. Pass `c.lim` / `control = evinf_control(c.lim = ...)` to override.
#> Warning: C_EV equalled the lower endpoint (173) in 1 of 5 bootstrap replicates; consider widening c.lim.
augment(model)
